coordinates: Metres in the standard YAM station: x forward, y left, z up.

wheel.rim_material: aluminium, nominal E=69 GPa; hollow section response uncalibrated
wheel.nipples: Brass, 12 mm long, 3.23 mm square wrench flats, nominal 0.454 mm thread pitch
wheel.reset_note: The four offsets are relative to the same nominal 700 N balanced reference; other offsets are zero. Label spoke 0 at the bottom; number around the rim counterclockwise viewed from +x. This is a proposed engineering reset, not calibrated commercial-wheel tension data.

stand.attachment: Base bolted to table; uprights stand240mm behind axle, with top arms extending forward to clamp axle ends. Hub rotates on its bearings; bottom nipple/tool sweep remains open.
stand.pointer: Steel20×2×2mm pointer beside the bottom rim; the gap is measured with feeler gauges. No initial rim contact.

wrench.start: Lying flat, jaw toward +y; not attached to the robot or nipple.

assessor_tools: 0.1 mm feeler gauges, millimetre ruler, camera and mechanical spoke tensiometer with2mm round-steel conversion chart; used for judging, not available to the policy.
